summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend regression for the Satvik Capital redesign. All 12 pytest cases pass (root/persona/slots/appointments incl. 409 dup + email side-effect verified via backend log 202 Accepted, admin login incl. bad-password 401, appointments list, google/status=false, chat streaming with 'Satvik Capital' present and no 'mutual fund distributor'). Frontend Playwright verified: intro overlay with cycling script (observed 'സാത്വിക്') + skip, hero heading, navbar + all 7 nav testids, footer-arn contains the only 'Mutual Fund Distributor · ARN-349743' occurrence on the page (mfd/arn count=1, hero/about have no 'Distributor'), SIP calculator defaults ₹45.00 L / ₹1.26 Cr + SVG chart, Direct vs Regular has 7 rows, delta ₹48 L, direct ₹1.85 Cr, regular ₹2.33 Cr + SVG, booking flow end-to-end (picked future weekday 2026-09-21 10:00, filled name/phone, saw 'Your hour is reserved.', reset via booking-another-btn works), chat widget greeting mentions Satvik Capital and streamed reply to 'What is a SIP?' was rendered, contact links correct (tel/mailto/wa.me), admin login themed navy, dashboard shows appointments-table containing QA Test booking, google-connect-btn shows 'Google Calendar is not configured yet' toast, logout redirects back to /admin/login. No console errors other than the intentional 503 from google-connect click.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: notify_new_booking is scheduled after building doc dict but the created_at ISO conversion mutates the same dict later used elsewhere — safe here but note the pattern. No action needed.
server.py get_slots is invoked directly by create_appointment; raises HTTPException on out-of-range dates leading to 400 responses when a client posts an old/invalid date — acceptable.
Landing.jsx uses sessionStorage.getItem synchronously in useState initializer — fine for CSR but would break in SSR (non-issue for CRA).
seed_data_creation: Created two QA bookings during backend + frontend tests (name prefixed 'QA Test'); backend one was cancelled in cleanup. Frontend booking (QA Test UI on 2026-09-21 10:00 IST) remains — main agent may cancel via admin dashboard if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Backend pytest file: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env or /app/frontend/.env fallback. Intro overlay uses sessionStorage key sc_intro_seen; new browser context always shows it. Skip button triggers exit animation so overlay is briefly still in DOM ~600ms after click; wait >=1s before asserting hero interactivity. Footer testids footer-phone / footer-email are on the wrapping

, hrefs are on inner . Google calendar is intentionally unconfigured (configured:false is expected).
